sloka: तीरजैर्बहुभिर्वृक्षैः सम्तेरुर्यमुनाम् नदीम् ।ते तीर्णाः प्लवमुत्सृज्य प्रस्थाय यमुनावनात् ॥२-५५-२३॥
transliteration: tīrajairbahubhirvṛkṣaiḥ samteruryamunām nadīm ।te tīrṇāḥ plavamutsṛjya prasthāya yamunāvanāt ॥2-55-23॥

translations.english: Having crossed the river, they left the float and proceeded from the adjoining forest of Yamuna and reached the dark, cool banyan tree covered with lush green leaves.
